## The request flow

The service owns the use case. The repository owns persistence. Each boundary
can be understood independently.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A["Request"] --> B["Domain service"] --> C["Repository"]
```

## Compare the choices

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Current

The controller knows how records are stored.

```python
record = database.query(request.key)
return format_response(record)
```

### Proposed

```python
result = service.handle(request)
```

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Controller
  participant S as Service
  C->>S: handle(request)
  S-->>C: result
```
:::

## Responsibilities

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Service

- Validate domain rules
- Coordinate the use case
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Repository

- Read and write records
- Hide storage details
:::
::::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Tradeoff

An extra interface is worthwhile only when it hides meaningful complexity.
:::

| Concern | Owner |
|---|---|
| Use case | Service |
| Persistence | Repository |
